title: HSK1 Gate 21 · Late Qing
explanationEn: Gate 21: Late Qing. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第21关：清后期。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 清朝快要过去的时候，中国有很多难事。那时候，西方的国家做出了新的船，船又大又快，不用风也可以走。他们还有很多新东西，是中国没有的。因为这样，中国过了几十年很难的日子。
passageEn: As the Qing dynasty was nearing its end, China faced many difficulties. By then, countries in the West had built new ships, large and fast, that could move without wind. They had many other new things too, which China did not have. Because of this, China went through several very hard decades.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: As the Qing dynasty was nearing its end, China faced many difficulties.
comprehension.answer: 清朝快要过去的时候，中国有很多难事。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: They had many other new things too, which China did not have.
comprehension.answer: 他们还有很多新东西，是中国没有的。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 时候 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“时候”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 时候 (shíhou) means "time" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “时候”（shíhou）的意思是“time”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 中国 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“中国”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 中国 (Zhōngguó) means "China" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “中国”（Zhōngguó）的意思是“China”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 清朝快要过去的时候，中国有很多难事。

options.text: People had nowhere to live, and could only go up the mountains to live.
As the Qing dynasty was nearing its end, China faced many difficulties.
Long ago, a great flood came to China.
The flood went into the fields, and into many people's homes.
